2607.28269.title: Theia: Large-Scale Multimodal Captioning and Automated Validation of the Incidents1M Dataset for Data-Free Distillation
2607.28269.paper_summary: The deployment of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) in critical domains like disaster management requires high-quality multimodal datasets, especially for transferring knowledge via Data-Free Knowledge Distillation (DFKD). However, existing datasets in this domain either entirely lack descriptive text, such as Incidents1M, or suffer from severe text-image semantic misalignment, such as CrisisMMD. In this work, we present a novel methodology to construct and automatically validate a large-scale multimodal dataset for disaster response. Starting from the vision-only Incidents1M, we successfully recovered 100,000 images and generated high-fidelity textual descriptions using two distinct Qwen3.5 architectures: a 4B dense model and a 35B Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model. To ensure the generated captions provide reliable semantic anchoring for DFKD, we introduce an image-blind LLM-as-a-Judge validation pipeline leveraging Qwen3.5-9B. By intentionally obscuring the original image from the judge, this evaluator accurately simulates the modality gap of the student model during data-free distillation. Our evaluation across 173,179 label pairs demonstrates a high semantic agreement (78.65/100) between the two architectures. Furthermore, the automated evaluation reveals a conservative captioning behaviour, characterized by a high Precision (77.6%) and low Recall (46.0%). This minimizes the false positive noise, while simultaneously exposing underlying human annotation inconsistencies in the original ground truth. This work provides a scalable, LLM-validated multimodal dataset and a reproducible framework to advance cross-modal knowledge distillation.
2607.28269.paper_summary_zh: 在災難管理等關鍵領域中部署視覺-語言模型（VLMs）需要高品質的多模態數據集，特別是用於通過無數據知識蒸餾（DFKD）轉移知識。然而，該領域現有的數據集要麼完全缺乏描述性文本，例如Incidents1M，要麼遭受嚴重的文本-圖像語義不對齊，例如CrisisMMD。在這項工作中，我們提出了一種新穎的方法來構建和自動驗證大規模的多模態數據集以應對災難。從僅包含視覺的Incidents1M開始，我們成功恢復了100,000張圖像，並使用兩種不同的Qwen3.5架構生成了高保真的文本描述：一種是4B的密集模型，另一種是35B的專家混合（MoE）模型。為了確保生成的標題為DFKD提供可靠的語義錨定，我們引入了一種基於圖像盲的LLM作為評估者的驗證管道，利用Qwen3.5-9B。通過故意將原始圖像隱藏於評估者之外，這一評估者準確模擬了學生模型在無數據蒸餾過程中的模態差距。我們在173,179對標籤上的評估顯示出兩種架構之間的高語義一致性（78.65/100）。此外，自動評估顯示出保守的標題行為，其特徵是高精確度（77.6%）和低召回率（46.0%）。這最小化了假陽性噪聲，同時揭示了原始真實標註中的潛在不一致性。這項工作提供了一個可擴展的、經LLM驗證的多模態數據集和一個可重複的框架，以推進跨模態知識蒸餾。
